## Goal
`state.next_check_at` (`src/freemyid/state.py:141-152`) re-checks a removed or not-found broker every `Broker.recheck_interval_days` (`models.py:464`, default 30, range 1-365) and never learns. ROADMAP 3.3 asks for "relist detection with per-broker cadence learned from history". Add a pure helper `learned_interval_days(gaps, base, *, floor=7, cap=90) -> int` to `monitor.py`. `gaps` is a list of whole days between a removal and the same listing coming back. The helper returns a suggested interval: the base when there is not enough history, otherwise about half the median gap so the next check lands before the next relist, clamped to `floor..cap` and never above `base`. It is a suggestion only; nothing calls it yet, and `state.py` is not touched.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. No gaps, or fewer than 2: returns `base` (clamped to `floor..cap`).
2. Table test: gaps [10, 12, 14] with base 30 gives 6 clamped up to the floor 7; gaps [60, 80] with base 30 gives 30 (never above base); gaps [40, 50, 60] with base 90 gives 25 (median 50, halved); `base` below the floor returns the floor.
3. Non-positive, non-integer and absurd (over 3650) gaps are ignored; the result never raises and is always an int in `floor..cap`.
4. Deterministic: same input in any order gives the same answer.
5. Argument checks: `floor > cap` or `floor < 1` raise `ValueError`.
6. Existing monitor tests and WO-211/226/256/271 tests pass unchanged; the monitor/1 JSON shape is unchanged.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
